output: pdf_document
---

```{r libraries, message= F}
library(tidyverse)
library(FAOSTAT)
```

```{r read in data}
countries <- read.csv("../../subsaharan_data/subsahran_africa_countries.csv")
food_security <- get_faostat_bulk_api("FS") |> 
  filter(nchar(year) == 4, unit == "%") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = item) |> group_by(year, area) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ first(na.omit(.))), .groups = "drop") |> select(area, year, "Prevalence of severe food insecurity in the male adult population (percent) (annual value)",
         "Prevalence of severe food insecurity in the female adult population (percent) (annual value)", 
         "Prevalence of severe food insecurity in the total population (percent) (annual value)") 
```

```{r}
# fix read in errors for names
food_security |> mutate(area = case_when(
    area == "CÃ´te d'Ivoire" ~ "Cote d'Ivoire",
    area == "TÃ¼rkiye" ~ "Turkiye",
    TRUE ~ area  # Keep other values unchanged
  ),
  year = as.numeric(year)) -> food_security
countries |> mutate(Country = case_when(
  Country == "C\xf4\xb4te d'Ivoire" ~ "Cote d'Ivoire",
  TRUE ~ Country
)) -> countries
# all countries match
food_security |> filter(area %in% countries$Country) |> select(area) |>
  unique() 
# save data
food_security <- food_security |> 
  filter(area %in% countries$Country, year >= 2000)
write.csv(food_security, "../../subsaharan_data/food_insecurity.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
